integrity: Exact Schur identity proof and BDF5 rational counterexample; code verifies symbolic claims; numerical sample is non-exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Only variable-coefficient BDF4 on fixed positive two-periodic grids for y'=0. No arbitrary-grid, nonzero-ODE, uniform-in-r, or finite-horizon accuracy theorem. Earlier specialist full texts not completely accessible; independent validation not performed.
title: Unrestricted two-periodic zero stability of variable-coefficient BDF4, with a BDF5 obstruction
